correctness.rationale: Every forbidden face is exactly an intact n-edge star. A nonrectangular hole has a surviving inside-rectangle edge in no star, a cone witness. Rectangular faults have distinct private star edges and all remaining edges covered. The proved private-element suspension lemma suspends once per nonprivate edge and ends at the augmented empty-face complex, giving a sphere in integral homotopy dimension n^2-|R||C|-2n+|R|+|C|-1. Exhaustive complete mod-two computations pass on all 14+510 small faults and 15 rectangle types at n=4; these are not relied on for infinite validity.
